Deadly Duck.name: Deadly Duck
Deadly Duck.summary: Deadly Duck's job is to score points by blasting his enemy the Crabs, their Bricks and the Dragonflies. Deadly can keep shooting as long as he avoids getting bonked by a falling Brick or hit by a Dragonfly's Bomb.

Quest for Quintana Roo.name: Quest for Quintana Roo
Quest for Quintana Roo.summary: Yucatan Sam explores the temples of Quintana Roo searching for the keys to open the ceremonial vault and acquire the riches inside.

Rubik's Cube.name: Atari Video Cube
Rubik's Cube.summary: Help Hubie the Cube Master solve the magical Atari Video Cube. He picks up and drops colors at your command - and you have billions of possible combinations! Atari Video Cube is fast-paced fun for the whole family!

Space Tunnel.name: Space Tunnel
Space Tunnel.summary: Space Tunnel is an action game developed by Bit Corp. and released on Atari 2600. In Space Tunnel\Space Robot you fly at hyper speed to an unknown galaxy's center and encounter strange creatures.

Treasure Island.name: Treasure Island
Treasure Island.summary: Explore the Island, treasures are hidden there in unbelievable abundance. Your boat trip there is full of dangers: whales and sharks will attack you. The natives are tirelessly bombarding you. And of course rivals have also started looking for the treasures for themselves. You have an unlimited supply of bumps to use against them but only 6 lives to wager!
